GREENVILLE, S.C., Sept. 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- United Community Banks, Inc. (NYSE: UCB) announces it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, before the stock market opens. The company will hold a conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, to discuss its financial results, business highlights, and outlook.


Participants can pre-register for the conference call by navigating to[https://dpregister.com/sreg/10209322/1040c6adc70](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Z5cB84NNLjpip45GWQJg82QOz3I-MqIjSh5O3-jDC4LiOBkTwrlNAyfHeZZYQZ4X8gPPbZN2NAyF9AWS4B8R_X_3nx22q-DaxraKob0Ep8mgSD0O5qh-_UJEsgoyO94fj7ibIyS4OEzfO0Pqkub4XuJFSClWt_kg-pBDPelaToJKRLf7JwGPEe5ToLGKqeE5LpS95orD-nUwcPnTLfzg_MNm6Pg6vNhPFbLw9i0WMaI=) . Those without internet access or unable to pre-register may dial in by calling 1-844-676-1337. The conference call will also be webcast and can be accessed by selecting “Events and Presentations” under “News and Events” within the Investor Relations section of the company's website,[ucbi.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=kh832jd15xR3kf-V78hs49PGLxHdA9tUBhu4rLOh2w8Fn1aQio4BB0nsDHFFUltRtzmlbC1v5UAQsqFws4zH0g==) .


**About United Community Banks, Inc.**


United Community Banks, Inc. (NYSE: UCB) is the financial holding company for United Community, a top-100 U.S. financial institution committed to building stronger communities and improving the financial health and well-being of its customers. United Community offers a full range of banking, mortgage and wealth management services. As of June 30, 2026, United Community Banks, Inc. had $29.1 billion in assets and operated 200 offices across Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina and Tennessee. The company also manages a nationally recognized SBA lending franchise, extending its reach to businesses across the country. United Community is the most awarded bank in the Southeast for Retail Banking Customer Satisfaction by J.D. Power, earning more awards than any other bank in the region, including recognition in 12 of the last 17 years. The company has also been named one of the “Best Banks to Work For” by *American Banker* for nine consecutive years. In commercial banking, United Community earned multiple 2026 Greenwich Best Bank awards for Small Business Banking. *Forbes* has consistently named United Community among the World’s Best and America’s Best Banks. Learn more at[ucbi.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=kh832jd15xR3kf-V78hs48Vv07sZLBPB0z3qQUB6ib8ygNJyajqQwGOxHgD6HrBb6sZrQHs72gJK-Vmn36_nMA==) .
